snippet.title: Final Third | Official Gameplay Trailer | Physics-Driven PvP Football Game
snippet.description:
Football, Unscripted.
↘️Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3994040/Final_Third/

Final Third is a physics-driven PvP football (soccer) game for up to 4v4.
The ball is a real physics object, so where it goes is on you.
No goalkeepers, no set positions.
The whole team defends, and the whole team scores.
Make it your game with Perks that change how you play and a Hub to show off how you look.

PLAYTEST SCHEDULE (Oct 29 to Nov 1, 2026)
• 8PM to 12AM ET
• 5PM to 9PM PT

Request access on the Steam page above and play from day one.

PLEASE NOTE
• Servers are in North America for this test. Players from other regions can join, but expect higher ping.
• PC (Steam) only.
• English only.
• This is a playtest. Expect bugs, crashes, and balance changes between sessions.

JOIN THE COMMUNITY
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/dX7D7AGtzM
Notion: final-third.notion.site
